items.teaser: Die Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für unmittelbare und mittelbare Ausfuhren nach Russland (Anlagen C 6 und C 7) wurden aktualisiert und sind ab sofort auf der BAFA-Internetseite abrufbar.

items.title: Fire reported near oil refinery in Russia's Rostov Oblast amid Ukrainian drone attack
items.teaser: Ukraine's military launched a drone attack on Russia's Rostov Oblast overnight on Nov. 28, reportedly striking the area near the Novoshakhtinsk Oil Refinery, Telegram monitoring channels reported.

items.title: 9/11-Attentäter wohnten in Hamburg in "Terror-WG" - Motassadeq verhaftet
items.teaser: Die Anschläge vom 11. September 2001 in den USA erschütterten die ganze Welt. Am 28. November 2001 wurde "Terrorhelfer" Motassadeq in Hamburg verhaftet.

items.title: Sicherheit - Flugbetrieb in Köln-Bonn nach Drohnensichtung gestoppt
items.teaser: Eine Drohne hat den Betrieb am Flughafen Köln/Bonn für über zwei Stunden lahmgelegt.

items.title: Nine more children return to Ukraine through Melania Trump’s efforts
items.teaser: Nine more children have been returned to Ukraine from the temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine and from Russia, thanks to the efforts of Melania Trump.

items.title: Polish prosecutors reveal expert findings on causes of Smolensk air disaster
items.teaser: The Smolensk air disaster on 10 April 2010 was caused by a series of events during the final stage of the landing manoeuvre, including the aircraft’s unstable descent, an incorrect assessment of its actual altitude and a belated decision to abort the landing.

items.title: 'Normal staffing issue' — IAEA chief dismisses criticism over appointment of sanctioned Russian as deputy
items.teaser: The official in question, Alexey Ferapontov, serves as the deputy head of the Russian Federal Service for Environmental, Technological and Nuclear Supervision. He was sanctioned by Ukraine in February 2023 over his role in "legitimizing the illegal seizure of the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant and extending Russian r

items.title: Ukraine's tattoo identification database for unidentified bodies now contains nearly 1,000 images
items.teaser: The database of tattoo images found on unidentified bodies in Ukraine now contains nearly 1,000 entries.

items.title: Russian soldier who was 13 when Russia launched full-scale invasion killed in Ukraine, media reports
items.teaser: It remains unclear when or how he joined the Russian military or where exactly he was killed.

items.title: EUROCONTROL extends support for Ukraine's air navigation system through 2028
items.teaser: EUROCONTROL member states have agreed to extend the European ATM Voluntary Solidarity Fund for another two years, covering 2027 and 2028.

items.title: Ukraine's Missing Persons Register now holds data on over 117,000 people
items.teaser: The Unified Register of Persons Missing Under Special Circumstances currently contains information on more than 117,000 people.

items.title: Russian troops love fog. So far this year, there’s way less of it.
items.teaser: Less fog and better Ukrainian drones could mean a very hard winter for Russian forces in eastern Ukraine.

items.title: Russian commanders threatened with being sent on assault missions over lack of progress in Zaporizhzhia sector – ATESH
items.teaser: The Russian military command is threatening to send commanders on assault missions over the lack of progress in the Zaporizhzhia sector.

items.title: The Soviets starved Ukraine, then erased the memory: how Stalin’s genocidal famine vanished from one Luhansk family’s story
items.teaser: Olena Zotova grew up hearing her great-grandmother call it holodomor and her grandmother only holod, famine, and understood what that difference held only after Russia's full-scale invasion.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Kremenchuk injures 4, including 3 children
items.teaser: In Kremenchuk, a Russian drone attack damaged two educational institutions in the city center, Poltava Oblast Governor Vitalii Diakivnych reported.

items.title: Germany locks in €11.6 billion for Ukraine’s defense next year. Parliament also lets Berlin sign deals now and pay through 2031
items.teaser: Bundestag passes 2027 budget 316 to 260, keeping Ukraine's line slightly above this year's funding.

items.title: Hungary lifts entry ban on Ukrainian Commander Robert ‘Magyar’ Brovdi
items.teaser: Hungary has lifted the entry and residence ban imposed on Robert Brovdi, Commander of the Unmanned Systems Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, who is known by the call sign “Magyar.”

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Zelensky confirms to Meloni that Ukraine did not coordinate Libya operation with Europe
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky has confirmed to Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni that the operation in Libya was carried out without prior coordination with European partners.

items.title: Russian troops attempting to infiltrate Stepnohirsk in Zaporizhzhia region – military
items.teaser: Russian troops are attempting to infiltrate Stepnohirsk in the Zaporizhzhia region to build up their manpower and establish positions there. However, Ukrainian defenders are detecting and destroying enemy groups before they can reach the settlement.

items.title: Russian drone attack damages two educational facilities in Kremenchuk, injuring two children
items.teaser: Two educational facilities were damaged and two children injured in a Russian drone attack on Kremenchuk, Poltava region.

items.title: Lithuania was late to debunk Russia’s “NATO attack” scare over Kaliningrad. It could have prebunked it instead
items.teaser: A story about Ukraine plotting a provocation in Kaliningrad ran in five languages two days before the sirens, and anyone watching could have read it, argues Repsense CEO Mykolas Katkus.

items.title: Zelensky meets with Liberia's Foreign Minister
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed potential areas of cooperation with Liberia's Foreign Minister Sara Beysolow Nyanti, focusing primarily on agriculture, as well as education and healthcare.

items.title: Russian military flotilla en route to Libya turns back after Ukrainian attack on ships – Reuters
items.teaser: A Russian flotilla in the Mediterranean transporting military equipment to Libya has turned back after Ukrainian naval drones struck Russian vessels in the port of Benghazi, with sources confirming another convoy also altered course off North Africa.

items.title: Cabinet approves revised 2027 State Budget for second reading, allocating nearly UAH 5 trillion to defense
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers has approved the revised draft State Budget for 2027 ahead of its second reading in parliament.

items.title: IAEA verhandelt über neunte begrenzte Waffenruhe, um wichtige Reparaturen für AKW Saporischschja zu ermöglichen
items.teaser: Die Internationale Atomenergiebehörde (IAEA) verhandelt mit der Ukraine und Russland über eine bereits neunte begrenzte Waffenruhe, um die Wiederherstellung der externen Stromversorgung des russisch besetzten Kernkraftwerks Saporischschja zu ermöglichen. Die Anlage wird derzeit mit Notstrom aus Dieselgeneratoren gekühl

items.title: Rheinmetall may drop plans to build ammunition plant in Ukraine, CEO says
items.teaser: The project, first announced in February 2024, has faced repeated delays, with Papperger previously citing bureaucratic hurdles in Ukraine.

items.title: Zelenskyy confirms that attack on Russian ship in Libya was not coordinated with Ukraine’s partners
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has confirmed after speaking with Giorgia Meloni that Ukraine did not coordinate its recent strike on Russian ships near Libya with European partners and has promised direct, regular information sharing.

items.title: Germany votes through nearly 12 billion euros in Ukraine support for 2027
items.teaser: Germany's new budget will bridge almost half of an expected shortfall in Kyiv's 2027 finances on its own.

items.title: Delays in supporting Ukraine could force Europeans to spend more on their own defense – FM Sybiha
items.teaser: Delays in decisions on supporting Ukraine could ultimately cost European countries significantly more in spending to defend their own territory.

items.title: Death toll in Russian strike on Nizhyn rises to three, seven injured
items.teaser: Three people were killed and seven others injured in a Russian strike on an industrial facility in Nizhyn, Chernihiv region.

items.title: Anschläge auf Parteibüros: Prozess in Flensburg gestartet
items.teaser: Vor Gericht räumte der Angeklagte die Angriffe ein und begründete dies mit seinem Frust über die Arbeit der etablierten Parteien.

items.title: CDU, Grüne, SPD und Linke getroffen - Ex-Politiker gesteht Anschläge auf Parteibüros
items.teaser: Daniel Lux erklärt seine Molotowcocktail-Attacken auf Parteibüros als politisches Zeichen.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: Ukraine hits missile fuel production facility in Russia's Tula Oblast, military says
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 27: Ukraine hits missile fuel production facility in Russia's Tula Oblast, military says Starshield speed restrictions apply only to Russian-occupied territories, hamper Ukraine's middle strike campaign, military sources say Ukraine's Azov announces 'Hell-3' operation, destroys Russian fuel dep

items.title: EU-Ukraine Drone Alliance may triple its number of participants
items.teaser: According to Rapporteur and European Commission confirmation, the EU-Ukraine Drone Alliance intends to expand from 18 to 80 members as it advances joint UAV production and a shared market.

items.title: Sybiha: Schwarzes Meer sollte nicht zweite Straße von Hormus für Lebensmittellieferungen werden
items.teaser: Durch russische Angriffe auf Schiffe und die Blockade des Schwarzen Meeres könnten über 30 Millionen Tonnen ukrainischen Getreides nicht ausgeführt werden, was zu einem neuen Anstieg der weltweiten Lebensmittelpreise führen könnte. In diesem Zusammanehang ruft die Ukraine dazu auf, den internationalen Druck auf Moskau

items.title: Zelensky acknowledges Ukraine did not coordinate Libya strike with European partners
items.teaser: Ukrainian naval drones struck the Russian Navy corvette Merkury at the port of Benghazi in Libya on Nov. 22.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russia's latest Buk-M3 air defense system in occupied territory
items.teaser: On November 26 and overnight into November 27, Ukraine's Defense Forces struck Russia's most advanced Buk-M3 surface-to-air missile system, drone command posts and military warehouses in temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories.

items.title: Woman and abandoned animals she cared for evacuated from Balabyne in Zaporizhzhia Oblast
items.teaser: Zaporizhzhia Oblast Police and animal welfare volunteers have evacuated resident Iryna and the abandoned pets she cared for from Balabyne under anti-drone cover amid intensifying Russian attacks, with the animals set to be transported to Chernivtsi.

items.title: Starshield speed restrictions apply only to Russian-occupied territories, hamper Ukraine's middle strike campaign, military sources say
items.teaser: The restrictions, first introduced in October, have added to tensions between Kyiv and Washington over U.S. military and political support for Ukraine, while undermining Ukraine's ability to both strike Russian targets and defend against aerial attacks.

items.title: Ukrainian foreign minister warns Europe against delaying aid for Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has cautioned Europe against delaying military and macro-financial support, calling aid to Ukraine a matter of European self-preservation needed to match Russia's rising war budget.

items.title: Putin waging diplomatic aggression against the West – Czech opposition leader
items.teaser: Supporting Ukraine is important for the Czech Republic and the whole of Europe, as Putin is resorting to diplomatic aggression through his blatant demands and will not stop there.

items.title: Romania calls on NATO to help repel Russian hybrid attacks
items.teaser: Romanian Foreign Minister Dan Neculăescu has called on NATO to adopt joint measures against Russian hybrid threats – including cyberattacks, disinformation and Black Sea incidents – and warned that the Black Sea is becoming a weak spot in European security.

items.title: Russian attack on Pisochyn in Kharkiv region leaves eight injured, including three children
items.teaser: Eight people, including three children, were injured in a Russian attack on Pisochyn in the Kharkiv region.

items.title: Russia attacks Dnipropetrovsk Oblast over 20 times: one woman injured
items.teaser: According to regional head Oleksandr Hanzha, on 27 November Russian forces attacked Dnipro alongside the Pavlohrad, Synelnykove and Nikopol districts more than 20 times, damaging infrastructure and leaving a 74-year-old woman in a serious condition.

items.title: Ukraine's AI workforce grows 18%, but experienced engineers remain scarce, study shows
items.teaser: Some 79% of vacancies required experience with infrastructure and MLOps — the systems and processes used to deploy and maintain AI models. Yet only 19% of surveyed specialists rated their skills in this area highly, according to the study.

items.title: Ukraine hit oil, military facilities across 11 Russian regions over past week, Zelensky says
items.teaser: "Ukraine responds to every Russian strike absolutely justly," President Volodymyr Zelensky said. "Russia has been offered numerous options for de-escalation and ending this war, yet it has chosen war anyway."

items.title: Ukraine-Hilfen: Ronzheimer und AfD-Mann geraten aneinander
items.teaser: Hitzige Debatte zwischen Paul Ronzheimer und Markus Frohnmaier: In der phoenix runde geraten der Journalist und der AfD-Mann aneinander. Kern der Debatte: Hilfen für die Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian forces thwart Russian advance attempts, destroy armor before it reaches front lines
items.teaser: Russian troops are making sporadic attempts to advance using armored vehicles in the operational zone of the Operational Task Force South, but Ukrainian defenders are detecting and destroying the vehicles while they are still en route to their intended positions.

items.title: Generalstab bestätigt Angriff auf Produktionsstätte für Raketentreibstoff in der russischen Region Tula
items.teaser: Die Verteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben gemeinsam mit der Widerstandsbewegung "Tschornaja Iskra" ("Schwarzer Funke") in der Nacht auf den 27. November das Werk für synthetischen Kautschuk in Jefremow in der russischen Region Tula angegriffen, das an der Herstellung von Treibstoff für den Abschuss von Iskander-Raketen

items.title: Putin und sein Schattenkrieg: Forscher warnen vor verheerendem Anschlag
items.teaser: Russische Sabotage in Europa nimmt an Schärfe zu. Besonders Verkehrswege geraten ins Visier, der Ernstfall rückt näher.

items.title: Russia uses memes to hit Canadians where it hurts after brutal wildfires. One shows their prime minister throwing cash at Zelenskyy, expert says
items.teaser: Russia doesn't invent Canada's problems, the disinformation expert believes.

items.title: Eight injured, including children, in Russian attack on village near Kharkiv
items.teaser: Oleh Syniehubov has reported that eight people, including three children, sustained injuries on 27 November when Russian forces struck the Kharkiv suburb of Pisochyn.

items.title: German Rheinmetall may scrap launch of ammunition plant in Ukraine
items.teaser: Rheinmetall CEO Armin Papperger has said during a Capital Markets Day presentation in Hamburg that the German defence group is considering shelving plans to build an artillery ammunition plant in Ukraine due to slow progress and Kyiv's domestic production push.

items.title: Nach Terrorplänen in Köln: Bericht: Islamisten hatten auch Synagoge in Malmö im Visier
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft ist einer proiranischen Terrorzelle auf der Spur, die einen Anschlag auf die Kölner Synagoge geplant haben soll. Nach der Festnahme zweier Iraker gehen Ermittler davon aus, dass auch die Synagoge im schwedischen Malmö auf der Zielliste gestanden hat.

items.title: Fake accounts impersonate Kyiv Independent journalist to solicit footage of Russian attacks
items.teaser: Fraudulent accounts sought to impersonate Olesia Bida, a journalist with the Kyiv Independent’s War Crimes Unit, by contacting photographers and media outlets to request photos and videos documenting the aftermath of Russian attacks.

items.title: General Staff confirms strike on Tula factory producing fuel for Iskander missiles
items.teaser: On the night of 27 November, the Ukrainian Defence Forces, in coordination with the ‘Chernaya Iskra’ insurgent movement, struck the Yefremov synthetic rubber plant in the Tula Region of the Russian Federation, which is involved in the production of solid rocket fuel, in particular for ‘Iskander’ ballistic missiles.

items.title: Divisions deepen between EU member states after tense budget summit
items.teaser: An EU leaders summit on the bloc's seven-year budget fell apart amid divisions over how to fund Ukraine. The budget proposal also includes a 3% tax on US tech companies, in a bid for the EU to generate additional funds.

items.title: Lifelong gamer gets real Ukraine’s Vampire bomber drone. Once UN children’s agency worker, he now hits Russian targets along border
items.teaser: "I had no idea what a Vampire was," he recalls.

items.title: Ukraine destroys concealed Russian army oil depot in Operation Hell-3
items.teaser: The SxLüd unit of the 1st Corps of the National Guard’s ‘Azov’ and the Signum battalion of the 59th Separate Assault Brigade of Unmanned Systems of the 9th Army Corps destroyed a Russian invaders’ oil depot hidden in the forest as part of Operation ‘Hell-3’.

items.title: What Ukraine’s FPV footage doesn’t show: psychology of killing
items.teaser: The Kyiv Independent’s Nick Allard and Asami Terajima speak with Ukrainian drone operators about what it means to kill enemy soldiers through a screen.

items.title: Bulgaria holding EU's 22nd Russia sanctions package hostage in bid to extract concessions
items.teaser: Bulgaria's push to have the EU allow Russian iron imports to resume comes as Moscow does everything in its power to limit a competitor closer to home from being able to help — Ukraine.

items.title: Neun weitere Kinder aus besetzten Gebieten unter Vermittlung von Melania Trump in die Ukraine zurückgebracht
items.teaser: Neun weitere Kinder aus den vorübergehend besetzten Gebieten sind unter Vermittlung von Melania Trump in die Ukraine zurückgebracht worden, schreibt der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj auf Facebook.

items.title: Germany adopts 2027 budget with record borrowing, including €12bn in aid for Ukraine
items.teaser: German lawmakers have backed the 2027 budget by 317 votes to 260, approving €12 billion in aid for Ukraine, record €210 billion in borrowing and nearly €140 billion for defence.

items.title: Terrorverdächtiger Ameer J. hätte abgeschoben werden müssen
items.teaser: Einer der mutmaßlichen Terroristen, die Anschläge auf die Kölner Synagoge und weitere jüdische Einrichtungen geplant haben sollen, hätte längst abgeschoben werden können. FOCUS online rekonstruiert die Vorgeschichte.

items.title: In Köln geduldet gelebt: Festgenommener Iraker seit zwei Jahren ausreisepflichtig
items.teaser: Einer der beiden am Donnerstag unter dem Verdacht der Mitgliedschaft in einer terroristischen Gruppe festgenommenen Iraker ist einem Medienbericht zufolge schon seit zwei Jahren ausreisepflichtig gewesen.

items.title: Ukraine's Azov announces 'Hell-3' operation, destroys Russian fuel depot in occupied Donetsk Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces had concealed the fuel depot and attempted to protect it with camouflage, electronic warfare systems and mobile fire groups, but the Ukrainian units managed to destroy both the storage site and its supporting logistics infrastructure, Azov said.

items.title: Zelensky chairs meeting on Kyiv situation attended by Klitschko
items.teaser: During a meeting of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief’s Headquarters of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, the logistics situation in Kyiv was discussed in the event of a significant deterioration of the situation due to Russian strikes. Among the speakers was the capital’s mayor, Vitali Klitschko.

items.title: Poland warns of anti-Ukrainian fake news regarding Ukrainian man who set himself on fire in Warsaw
items.teaser: Warsaw police spokesperson Jakub Pacyniak warned on 27 November that false claims, fake farewell letters and conspiracy theories are circulating online to incite anti-Ukrainian sentiment after a 22-year-old Ukrainian man set himself on fire outside the Presidential Palace.

items.title: Spox Pletenchuk: Russia seeks alternative supply routes for troops after partial collapse of Kerch Bridge
items.teaser: Following the damage to the Kerch Bridge, the Russian Federation is unable to fully supply Crimea with everything required by the Russian occupying forces; however, they will attempt to route more supplies overland.

items.title: Reparaturteam von Stromnetzbetreiber in Saporischschja gerät unter russischen Beschuss
items.teaser: Techniker des Betreibers des Stromnetzes in der Region Saporischschja sind während der Wiederherstellung der Stromversorgung unter Beschuss geraten. Das ist bereits der vierte Vorfall in diesem Monat.

items.title: Was Kiew mit Angriffen auf russische Schiffe erreichen will
items.teaser: Die Ukraine hat zuletzt russische Schiffe fernab der eigenen Grenzen vor Finnland und Libyen angegriffen. Militärexperte Gressel erklärt, wie diese Angriffe einzuschätzen sind.

items.title: Ukraine brings back 11 people from occupation and Russia, including children and deported Oleshky care home resident – photos
items.teaser: Ukraine has brought back nine children from occupied Kherson, Zaporizhzhia and Crimea alongside two women, including deported Oleshky care home resident Anastasiia Mamotiuk, bringing repatriations assisted by Melania Trump to 40.

items.title: Russia developing new satellite communications system for military use, HUR says
items.teaser: Innosat is a new low-Earth-orbit satellite project developed by St. Petersburg-based Geoscan as part of Russia's 10-year plan to deploy 240 satellites by 2036.

items.title: Ukrainian woman seeks love on Telegram and finds a handler instead. He gave her a task against a former border guard
items.teaser: Investigators have not said who the handler works for and are checking whether she worked for Russian intelligence.

items.title: Die internationalen Drohnen-Allianzen der Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukrainisches Know-how trifft auf Europas finanzielle und industrielle Stärke: Deutschland und andere Partner bauen ihre Drohnenproduktion mit der Ukraine aus. Das verändert auch Europas Rüstungsindustrie.

items.title: FM Sybiha: Russia seeks to include oil exports in Black Sea agricultural truce deal
items.teaser: Ukraine is proposing that the ceasefire agreements in the Black Sea focus on the safety of maritime navigation and the transport of agricultural produce, whilst Russia is attempting to include the issue of oil exports in them.

items.title: Ukraine strike plant critical to Russia's Iskander missile programme
items.teaser: Ukraine's Special Operations Forces working with the Chornaya Iskra insurgent movement have struck the Yefremov Synthetic Rubber Plant in Russia's Tula Oblast overnight on 26-27 November, hitting a key producer of Iskander rocket propellant components.

items.title: Italy denies that Zelenskyy coordinated attack on Russian ship in Libya with partners
items.teaser: Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani denies that Ukraine coordinated its operation against a Russian ship in Libya with international partners.

items.title: Sicherheit - "Spiegel": Proiranische Gruppe plante auch Anschlag auf Synagoge in Schweden
items.teaser: Im Fall der mutmaßlichen Terrorgruppe, die einen Anschlag auf eine Kölner Synagoge geplant haben soll, gibt es offenbar auch eine Spur nach Schweden.

items.title: Bundesgerichtshof - Früherer BND-Chef Hanning scheitert mit Haftbeschwerde
items.teaser: Der unter Spionageverdacht stehende frühere BND-Präsident Hanning ist erfolglos gegen seine Untersuchungshaft vorgegangen.

items.title: Croatian court overturns extradition ruling against Ukrainian suspect in Nord Stream sabotage case
items.teaser: The law firm representing Volodymyr Zhuravliov said Croatia's High Criminal Court returned the case to the lower court for reconsideration.

items.title: Russen greifen Infrastruktur in Sumy und Schytomyr an: ein Mensch getötet und zwei weitere verletzt
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Angriff auf ein ziviles Unternehmen in der Gemeinde Malyn ist eine Person ums Leben gekommen. Zwei weitere Personen wurden verletzt, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Vitalij Bunetschko, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Zelenskyy wants strikes to further disrupt Russian military production
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukraine has adjusted its long-range operational plan to further slow Russian military production and certain economic processes.

items.title: Russian forces prepare for winter and new landings on Kherson’s Karantynny Island, Pivden reports
items.teaser: Russian troops in the Kherson region are attempting to prepare for winter conditions, despite logistical difficulties, and remain determined to land in the area of the Korabel neighbourhood on Karantynnyi Island in Kherson.

items.title: Selenskyj zu Ergebnissen ukrainischer Langstreckenangriffe: Ölanlagen, Rüstungsbetriebe und Militärflugplätze in Russland innerhalb einer Woche getroffen
items.teaser: Diese Woche haben die Verteidigungskräfte russische Ölanlagen, Rüstungsweke sowie Militärflugplätze und Flugzeuge getroffen.

items.title: Spionageverdacht: Ex-BND-Chef Hanning bleibt in Untersuchungshaft
items.teaser: Die Festnahme des Ex-BND-Chefs Hanning hatte im Oktober international Schlagzeilen produziert. Nun steht fest, dass der 80-Jährige vorerst in Haft bleibt. Gegen Hanning wird unter anderem wegen Spionageverdachts ermittelt.

items.title: 9 Ukrainian children returned from Russian-occupied territories, Russia through Melania Trump's mediation, Zelensky says
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said the children were brought back from Russian-occupied Crimea, as well as parts of Zaporizhzhia and Kherson oblasts.

items.title: Ukraine stops electricity exports as Russian attacks strain power grid
items.teaser: The shift highlights how damage to the electricity grid can leave Ukraine The shift shows the impact of Russian attacks on Ukraine's energy grid, as the country increasingly relies on imports to meet domestic needs while losing export revenue for Ukrainian producers.

items.title: An Abridged Tale of Tuvalu: State Continuity, De-Recognition, and Digital Sovereignty as Responses to Sea-Level Rise
items.teaser: On 24 September 2026, the United Nations (‘UN’) General Assembly approved by consensus the first UN Declaration on Sea Level Rise, affirming “the presumption in favour of continued statehood” vis-à-vis states threatened with deterritorialization on account of sea-level rise; the most vulnerable being low-lying island s

items.teaser: "Following my meeting with the Prime Minister of Hungary and, more broadly, what has effectively been a reset in relations between Hungary and Ukraine, our neighbors have joined our global coalition," President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: Ukraine seeks additional weapons from partners to protect infrastructure, Zelensky says
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has stated that Ukraine, together with its partners in Europe and other countries, is working to secure additional arms packages, in particular to strengthen the protection of infrastructure against various types of drones.

items.title: Zelensky posthumously honors Kyiv-Mohyla Academy's Viacheslav Briukhovetsky, who helped restore Ukraine's educational heritage
items.teaser: Under Briukhovetsky's leadership, the National University of Kyiv-Mohyla Academy broke with the Soviet model of education in Ukraine, and became one of the country's most respected educational institutions.

items.title: Friedensforscher: EU hat "keine Exit-Option"
items.teaser: Die EU versuche zwar, fehlende Finanzhilfen der USA für die Ukraine auszugleichen. Sie habe aber keine klare Strategie für Verhandlungen, sagt Friedensforscher Sascha Hach bei ZDFheute live.

items.title: Zelensky warns Russia is preparing new large-scale attack
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has called on Ukrainians to pay close attention to air-raid sirens in the coming days, following reports that Russia is preparing a new large-scale attack.

items.title: Ukraine has almost nothing to stop Russia’s ballistic missiles, presidential tech adviser says, listing seven weapons Kyiv needs
items.teaser: The list ends with lasers to develop and study, a day after he reported a Ukrainian laser's first kill of a Russian jet-powered drone.

items.title: tagesschau 20:00 Uhr
items.teaser: Einigung im Tarifstreit der Metall- und Elektroindustrie, Staats- und Regierungschefs der 27 EU-Länder beraten bei Sondergipfel über EU-Haushalt, Pablo Hernández de Cos soll neuer Präsident der Europäischen Zentralbank werden, AfD-Richtungsstreit über Migration, Zwei Iraker nach Razzia wegen Terrorverdacht festgenommen

items.title: Mutter eines gefallenen amerikanischen Freiwilligen will in der Ukraine ein Buch herausgeben, zu dessen Schreiben sie von ihrem Sohn inspiriert wurde
items.teaser: Die Mutter des in der Ukraine gefallenen amerikanischen Freiwilligen Hayden Fischer Miller, die Schriftstellerin Laura Racey Miller, möchte in der Ukraine das Kinderbuch „Night of the Cricket“ veröffentlichen. Zum Schreiben ist sie von ihrem Sohn inspiriert worden, sagte sie auf einer Pressekonferenz in der Nachrichten

items.title: Ilona W. soll Putins Diensten Türen in Berlin geöffnet haben
items.teaser: In Berlin steht seit Donnerstag die mutmaßliche Spionin Ilona W. vor Gericht. Laut Anklage soll die 57-Jährige für den russischen Geheimdienst GRU spioniert haben. Der Prozessauftakt zieht sich in die Länge – auch weil Ilona W. plötzlich übel wird.

items.title: Russian forces strike factory in Khmelnytskyi region
items.teaser: In the Khmelnytskyi district, a fire broke out on the premises of one of the enterprises as a result of a Russian attack.

items.title: Ukraine’s Neptune missiles hit Russian airbase used for glide-bomb attacks – fourth airbase hit in two weeks
items.teaser: The airbase hosts Su-34 fighter-bombers used in Russian attacks on Ukrainian cities and military positions. Kyiv also reported hitting an oil pumping station more than 1,000 kilometers from its border.

items.title: Fire breaks out at business premises in Khmelnytskyi district following Russian attack
items.teaser: Firefighters are battling a blaze at a company's premises in Khmelnytskyi district after a Russian attack on 26 November, with no casualties reported.

items.title: Threatened by Wagner, this Nigerian journalist uncovered Russia’s war machine in Africa
items.teaser: When Yevgeny Prigozhin called Nigerian investigative journalist Philip Obaji Jr. a "cockroach" in 2022, the Wagner Group chief threatened to make him pay for his reporting. A year later, Obaji found himself locked inside a shipping container full of the insects, as well as rats, in the Central

items.title: Ukraine war latest: North Korea halts military aid to Russia, Ukrainian intelligence says
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 26: North Korea pauses military aid to Russia, Ukrainian intelligence says Ukraine strikes 2 Russian oil facilities, air field in Volgograd Oblast, General Staff confirms Russia prepares new mass attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure, Zelensky says Zelensky appoints new commander of Ukraine

items.title: Ukraine invites Canada to join War Risk Insurance Fund
items.teaser: Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi has invited Canada to contribute to the War Risk Insurance Fund, which is due to be launched in January. Ukraine is also counting on an expansion of Canada’s preferential lending schemes and the attraction of investment into the private sector.

items.title: EU summit: decision on Ukraine postponed until December, €45bn loan and new mechanism discussed
items.teaser: EU leaders will delay a decision on a €45 billion loan for Ukraine until December while discussing a new mechanism for the 2028–2034 budget, sources say.

items.title: Ein Toter und vier Verletzte nach russischem Angriff auf Saporischschja
items.teaser: Heute haben russische Truppen die Stadt Saporischschja mit düsengetriebenen Drohnen angegriffen.

items.title: Dnipropetrovsk region comes under more than 50 attacks in one day, causing damage
items.teaser: Russian invaders launched more than fifty drone attacks on the Kryvyi Rih and Nikopol districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region throughout the day.

items.title: Zelensky appoints new commander of Ukraine's Support Forces
items.teaser: The post was previously held by Major General Dmytro Hereha, who served for nearly five years.

items.title: Ukraine, Russia could hold largest prisoner exchange of war before winter holidays, Kushner says
items.teaser: Budanov says Ukraine and Russia could carry out another exchange in the coming weeks, as Kyiv also explores a four-party meeting on peace involving European countries.

items.title: Russian strike on Komyshuvakha: Slidstvo.Info uncovers details about perpetrators
items.teaser: Slidstvo.Info uncovered details about Russian officers and pilots behind the 2 November airstrike on a school in Komyshuvakha that killed 72 people.

items.title: Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia kills one, injures four
items.teaser: Today, 26 November, Russian troops attacked Zaporizhzhia.

items.title: Ukrainian who set himself on fire in Warsaw is in intensive care in critical condition
items.teaser: Polish police confirmed the man who set himself on fire in Warsaw on 25 November is a Ukrainian citizen. He is in intensive care in critical condition.

items.title: Ukrainian NGOs urge EU to demand stronger reforms as Brussels reportedly accepts backsliding on rule of law
items.teaser: A Ukrainian civil society source familiar with the negotiations told the Kyiv Independent that representatives of the European Commission have succumbed to the Ukrainian authorities' pressure and agreed that "it was inappropriate to give international experts a decisive role in the selection of Supreme Court judges."

items.title: Trial of Berlin woman accused of spying for Russia begins after delay
items.teaser: Despite delays due to health issues, the trial of the Berlin woman accused of spying for Russia has begun. Prosecutors say the defendant used her military contacts to provide information on German defense and Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainische Drohnen setzen Ölraffinerie in der russischen Region Krasnodar in Brand
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 26. November haben Langstreckendrohnen des Militärgeheimdienstes (HUR) eine Ölraffinerie in der Stadt Slawjansk-na-Kubani in der Region Krasnodar attackiert.

items.title: Russia has lost nearly US$190bn in war against Ukraine – Russian media report
items.teaser: Russia spent RUB 43.6 trillion more on military needs over five years of war, losing RUB 18.6 trillion in unproductive spending, Novaya Gazeta Europe found.

items.title: Luftstreitkräfte zerstören Sammelbereich von russischen Truppen im Zentrum von Huljajpole
items.teaser: Das ukrainische Militär hat einen Luftangriff auf einen Sammelpunkt russischer Invasoren in der Stadt Huliaipole in der Region Saporischschja geflogen, teilt das 7. Schnelle Eingreifskorps der Luftlandetruppen auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Russian drones attack Dnipropetrovsk Oblast 50 times
items.teaser: Russian drones attacked two districts of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast more than 50 times on 26 November, damaging businesses, a kindergarten and infrastructure.

items.title: President Zelensky thanks Americans for their support in Thanksgiving message
items.teaser: Ukraine remains strong thanks to the support of many American friends.

items.title: Trump says he urged Putin to 'pull back' military aggression in Europe
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump claimed that he talked with Vladimir Putin about ceasing Russia's military aggression in Europe and expressed his belief in the possibility of a deal between Russia and Ukraine.

items.title: Trump's version of joint statement with Rutte urges both Ukraine and Russia to avoid actions that could expand war
items.teaser: Donald Trump's version of a joint statement with NATO chief Mark Rutte urges both Russia and Ukraine to avoid actions that could expand the war.

items.title: Ukraine hits Russian refinery in Krasnodar Krai, setting fire to key facilities
items.teaser: Drones of the Defense Intelligence of Ukraine (DIU) attacked an oil refinery in the city of Slavyansk-on-Kuban in Russia’s Krasnodar Krai overnight on November 26.

items.title: Italy, Germany caution against geographical expansion of Russia's war against Ukraine
items.teaser: Both Meloni and Wadephul reaffirmed their commitment to continue supporting Ukraine.

items.title: Russians attack Zaporizhzhia in the evening, killing one and injuring four
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia's Dniprovskyi district on the evening of 26 November, killing one person and injuring four, local authorities reported.

items.title: Militärgeheimdienst: Nordkorea setzt Militärhilfe für Russland, insbesondere Lieferung von ballistischen Raketen aus
items.teaser: Nordkoreas Außenministerin Choe Son Hui hat die Aussetzung der Militärhilfe an Russland angekündigt. Diese Entscheidung sei persönlich von Nordkoreas Machthaber Kim Jong-un getroffen worden, wie der ukrainische Militärgeheimdienst (HUR) mitteilt.

items.title: China may seek U.S. concessions on Taiwan in exchange for pressuring Russia – expert
items.teaser: China may have an interest in ending the Russian-Ukrainian war to preserve its economic ties with Europe, while expecting concessions from the United States on Taiwan in return.

items.title: How many countries have recognized the Holodomor as genocide? See all 32 on our map
items.teaser: More than half of them voted after Russia's full-scale invasion. See who voted and when, checked against each parliament's own text.

items.title: Zelenskyy addresses Americans on Thanksgiving
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy congratulated Americans on Thanksgiving on 26 November, thanking them for supporting Ukraine against Russia.

items.title: Ukrainian aviation strikes Russian troop hub in Huliaipole
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces carried out an airstrike on a Russian troop staging point in Huliaipole, Zaporizhzhia region.

items.title: Trump says he asked Putin to stop military aggression in Europe
items.teaser: Donald Trump says he asked Vladimir Putin during talks in China to stop military aggression across Europe and reach a peace agreement with Ukraine quickly.

items.title: Father and his three children evacuated from Nikopol under cover of darkness
items.teaser: White Angels police evacuated a 39-year-old father and his three children from frontline Nikopol after dark, marking the family's third evacuation attempt.

items.title: Ukrinform featured on interactive Map of Recommended Media
items.teaser: A total of 317 Ukrainian media outlets, including Ukrinform, have been added to the interactive Map of Recommended Media for the second half of 2026.

items.title: Germany follows Italy in warning Ukraine against "geographical" expansion of war
items.teaser: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul backs Ukraine's right to self-defence but warns against the conflict spreading geographically, citing risks to Baltic Sea shipping and the environment.

items.title: Trump tells Putin to 'pull back all military aggression' across Europe
items.teaser: "During my conversations in China with President Vladimir Putin of Russia, I spent a lot of time talking about the fact that I would like to see President Putin pull back all Military aggression against territories throughout Europe," U.S. President Donald Trump said.

items.title: Russland übergibt Überreste von 250 Soldaten an Ukraine
items.teaser: Russland hat der Ukraine 250 Leichen vermutlich von ukrainischen Soldaten übergeben, teilt der Stab für Gefangenenbelange auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Kyiv is reportedly weighing cuts to the Flamingo missile. But now steered like an FPV drone, it does a job the Neptune can’t
items.teaser: The Neptune hits more reliably at long range, but the Flamingo's 1,150-kg warhead is heavier than anything else Ukraine builds.

items.title: “Deliveries are still delayed”—Ukraine’s leader on the US Patriot missiles meant to stop Russian ballistic strikes
items.teaser: Zelenskyy told his country the key priority is speeding up partners' missile deliveries, then said Washington has brought no good news on that yet.

items.title: Large-scale power outage hits Russian-occupied Crimea, disrupts transport
items.teaser: The outage comes amid weeks of electricity shortages across the Russian-annexed Crimean Peninsula.

items.title: Ukrainian aircraft destroy Russian staging point in centre of Huliaipole – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian aircraft struck a Russian staging point in central Huliaipole, killing up to 20 soldiers and destroying ammunition, antennas and ground drones.

items.title: Ukraine receives $450 mln from World Bank with Japanese government support
items.teaser: Ukraine has received $450 million from the World Bank, backed by guarantees from the Japanese government, under two programs: RISE, to support businesses, and SURGE, to support reconstruction.

items.title: French presidential candidate: "The war in Ukraine is our war because we are targets of Putin"
items.teaser: French presidential candidate Raphaël Glucksmann says the war in Ukraine is also France's war, arguing that stopping aid to Kyiv would undermine the country's vital interests.

items.title: Vier Polizist:innen bei russischem Angriff in Saporischschja getötet
items.teaser: Infolge eines russischen Angriffs auf Saporischschja sind vier Kriminalpolizist:innen ums Leben gekommen.

items.title: Russian plans to reach Kramatorsk and Sloviansk by winter completely foiled – military
items.teaser: Russian forces had planned to reach Kramatorsk and Sloviansk before the start of winter, but actions by Ukraine’s Defense Forces have forced them to focus on stabilizing their own positions rather than advancing further.

items.title: World Bank provides Ukraine with US$450m to support businesses and reconstruction
items.teaser: The World Bank has provided Ukraine with US$450 million to support businesses and reconstruction, with funding disbursed based on the achievement of performance targets.

items.title: GPS disruptions reported in Estonia, Sweden and Finland when drone attacked Russian vessel
items.teaser: Severe GPS disruptions affect Stockholm, Tallinn and Helsinki, with interference also reported near Gotland and the Åland Islands during the weekend Ukraine struck a Russian vessel.

items.title: Zahl der Verletzten bei russischem Angriff auf Charkiw steigt auf acht, eine Person getötet
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Verletzten in Charkiw infolge eines russischen Angriffs ist auf acht gestiegen, eine Person ist gestorben.

items.title: Ukraine’s own probe blames Russian troops for a 2024 tear-gas attack—and the OPCW says Kyiv’s evidence handling meets its standards
items.teaser: Russia's envoy claimed the 79-page report rests on a fabricated post from a defunct Telegram channel, while 35 countries and the EU welcomed the report.

items.title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Kharkiv rises to eight, one killed
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian attack on Kharkiv has risen to eight, while one person was killed.

items.title: Bundesanwaltschaft - Zwei mutmaßliche Mitglieder einer pro-iranischen Terrorgruppe in Köln und Heidelberg festgenommen
items.teaser: Im Zusammenhang mit einem geplanten Anschlag auf eine Synagoge in Köln sind zwei mutmaßliche Mitglieder einer pro-iranischen Terrorgruppe festgenommen worden.

items.title: 'Grandmaster of politics' who 'wants peace': Jared Kushner interview reveals how Trump's envoy sees Putin
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump's envoy and son-in-law, Jared Kushner, praised Russian President Vladimir Putin and repeated disputed Kremlin claims about Russia's war against Ukraine in a Nov. 25 interview with Politico, offering a glimpse into how one of Washington's key negotiators views Moscow

items.teaser: In the Book Review section of this issue, we invite readers to reflect on the language of international law and on the significance of the concepts, vocabularies and interpretive frameworks through which it seeks both to apprehend and to constitute the realities over which it claims authority. items.title: Resilience does not mean Ukrainians should have to cope alone
items.teaser: Ukrainians have shown extraordinary resilience in the face of Russia's full-scale invasion. But resilience cannot replace institutional responsibility. Protecting civilians now requires preparedness that anticipates threats, earns trust and is built with communities.

items.title: From laser to F-16 cannon: Ukraine shows six ways to down Russia’s jet drones in 13 days. But in October, a third got through
items.teaser: A laser and a ground robot joined the hunt, and a presidential adviser says it is too soon to discuss serial production of the laser.

items.title: Anschlag auf Synagoge in Köln geplant - Zwei mutmaßliche Islamisten festgenommen
items.teaser: Eine Gruppe soll einen Anschlag auf eine Kölner Synagoge geplant haben.

items.title: Ukraine repatriates 250 bodies Russia claims belong to Ukrainian soldiers
items.teaser: The recovery and return of fallen soldiers' corpses remains a major challenge.

items.title: Selenskyj: Russen seien dabei, Vorbereitungen auf neuen massiven Angriff auf Ukraine zu beenden
items.teaser: Russland sei dabei, Vorbereitungen auf einen neuen massiven Angriff auf die Ukraine zu beenden. „Nach Geheimdienstinformationen sollen Energieanlagen, Logistik und lebenswichtige Einrichtungen das Hauptziel des geplanten Angriffs werden“, schreibt der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj auf Facebook.

items.title: Italian PM warns Ukraine after attack on Russian vessel in Mediterranean Sea
items.teaser: Italian PM Giorgia Meloni has warned against the war spreading to the Mediterranean following Ukrainian strikes on Russian vessels near Libya's port of Benghazi.

items.title: Russia may stage new provocations against Poland during Christmas holidays – General Kraszewski
items.teaser: Russia may step up provocations against Poland ahead of the Christmas and New Year holidays, when public attention is focused on the festivities.

items.title: Russland: Sieben von zehn ermordeten Frauen Opfer häuslicher Gewalt
items.teaser: Der Krieg gegen die Ukraine hinterlässt auch in der Statistik zu häuslicher Gewalt in Russland Spuren. Eine Studie zeigt: Viele Täter sind Kriegsteilnehmer. Und Verfahren können ausgesetzt werden, wenn Beschuldigte in den Krieg ziehen. Von L. Becker.

items.title: Sie wissen, wie Coach Rapp tickt - Dynamo hat gleich zwei Pauli-Spione
items.teaser: Dresden braucht gegen St. Pauli einen Heimdreier - und zählt auf diese Erkenntnisse.

items.title: Mother of fallen U.S. volunteer hopes to publish in Ukraine children’s book inspired by her son
items.teaser: Laura Racy Miller, the mother of U.S. volunteer Hayden Fisher Miller, who was killed defending Ukraine, hopes to publish her children’s book Night of the Cricket in Ukraine. Inspired by her son, the story follows a cricket overcoming obstacles on its way to achieving its dream.

items.title: Generalstab meldet Treffer auf russischen Militärflugplatz „Marinowka“ und Transneft- Ölpumpstation
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 26. November haben die Verteidigungskräfte der Ukraine den Militärflugplatz „Marinowka“ in der russischen Region Wolgograd mit „Neptun“-Raketen angegriffen. Zudem wurde ein Treffer auf eine Ölpumpstation von Transneft in der Teilrepublik Baschkortostan - über 1.000 km von der ukrainischen Grenze entfer

items.title: Large-scale power outage reported in Crimea
items.teaser: A major blackout has affected Russian-occupied Crimea; Sevastopol is completely without electricity and outages have been reported in dozens of settlements across the peninsula.

items.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Angriffe auf Kiew - Tote in Saporischschja
items.teaser: Russland hat die Ukraine wieder massiv angegriffen. Auch bei einem ukrainischen Drohnenangriff im russisch besetzten Teil von Saporischschja gab es Tote. Beide Seiten tauschten die Leichen gefallener Soldaten aus.

items.title: He allegedly photographed supplies for Ukrainian soldiers while wearing a medical mask. Lithuanian prosecutors suspect he had been spying for Russia since 2021
items.teaser: Prosecutors say the case over the photos pointed to years of paid information gathering for Moscow.

items.title: Russian attack on Odesa kills 70-year-old man
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked Odesa and its suburbs, damaging infrastructure and killing a 70-year-old man.

items.title: Bodies of 250 fallen Ukrainians repatriated from Russia
items.teaser: The bodies of 250 deceased people have been returned to Ukraine. Russia claims they are those of Ukrainian service members.

items.title: Trump und Rutte rufen Putin auf, Krieg gegen Ukraine nicht auszuweiten
items.teaser: US-Präsident Donald Trump und der NATO-Generalsekretär Mark Rutte haben nach ihrem Treffen in Florida am 25. November eine gemeinsame Erklärung veröffentlicht.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Russian airfield and Transneft oil hub
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck the Marinovka airfield in Russia’s Volgograd region with Neptune missiles overnight on November 26. A hit was also recorded at a Transneft oil pumping station in Bashkortostan, more than 1,000 kilometers from the Ukrainian border.

items.title: Ukraine repatriates 250 bodies that Russia claims are Ukrainian military personnel
items.teaser: Ukraine brought back the bodies of 250 fallen individuals – identified by Russia as Ukrainian military personnel – on 26 November with Red Cross support, forensic examination and identification is to follow.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia preparing for another massive attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said Russian forces were completing preparations for another massive attack, with energy infrastructure, logistics and essential services likely to be targeted again.
